title: crataegus alabamensis var. teres
intro: Crataegus alabamensis var. teres, commonly known as a variety of the Alabama hawthorn, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and reducing inflammation due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus alabamensis var. teres are attributed to its ability to act as a cardiotonic, diuretic, and vasodilator, helping to regulate heart function, promote urine production, and widen blood vessels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
